units.source_text: “陪酒时主要是跳舞，后来让我去东京学习，也是学的舞蹈。

en.t: When I was entertaining guests, it was mainly dancing, and later, when they let me go to Tokyo to study, what I studied was dancing too.

units.source_text: 三弦琴只模模糊糊记得一点儿，忘了也没人给指点，就靠乐谱啦。”

en.t: I only vaguely remember a little of the shamisen, and if I forget, there is no one to guide me, so I have to rely on the sheet music.
